import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.stream.IntStream;

public class ghh {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;
    static int n;
    static long[] occ;
    static long[] nbr;

    static void countVertexes() {
        int half = n / 2;
        occ[0] = 1;
        nbr[0] = 1;

        for (int step = 1; step <= n; step++) {
            final int lim = Math.min(n - step, half);
            final long[] next = new long[half + 1];

            IntStream.rangeClosed(0, lim).forEach(j -> {
                long val = 0;
                if (j > 0) val += occ[j - 1];
                if (j < lim) val += occ[j + 1];
                else if (j == lim && lim < half) val += occ[lim + 1];
                next[j] = val % MOD;
            });

            long sum = IntStream.rangeClosed(0, lim).mapToLong(j -> next[j]).sum() % MOD;
            System.arraycopy(next, 0, occ, 0, lim + 1);
            nbr[step] = sum;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader in = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(in.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken()) * 2;
        occ = new long[n / 2 + 1];
        nbr = new long[n + 1];
        countVertexes();

        long res1 = IntStream.iterate(n - 1, i -> i - 2)
                .limit(n / 2)
                .mapToLong(i -> nbr[i])
                .sum() % MOD;

        PrintWriter out = new PrintWriter(new OutputStreamWriter(System.out));
        out.println(res1);
        out.flush();
    }
}
